Bailey-type factorizations for Horn functions.
Carlo Verschoor
2nd November 2020
Abstract
In this paper we are interested in extending Bailey’s identity to other classical
hypergeometric functions. Bailey’s identity states that under a suitable choice of
parameters, Appell’s F4 decomposes into a product of two 2F1’s. We will show how
Bailey-type factorizations can be found for Horn’s hypergeometric functions H1, H4
and H5.

Abstract: In this paper we are interested in extending Bailey’s identity to other classical hypergeometric functions. Bailey’s identity states that under a suitable choice of parameters, Appell’s F4 decomposes into a product of two 2F1’s. We will show how Bailey-type factorizations can be found for Horn’s hypergeometric functions H1, H4 and H5.
